findings.name: Invite workflow has defined start state
findings.finding: EmployeeInvite lifecycle starts at InviteStatus.PENDING

findings.name: Invite workflow has terminal states
findings.finding: Terminal states: ACCEPTED, REVOKED. Semi-terminal: EXPIRED (can resend back to PENDING).

findings.name: No unreachable invite states
findings.finding: All 4 states reachable from PENDING through valid transitions.

findings.name: No dead-end non-terminal states
findings.finding: PENDING has 3 outbound transitions. EXPIRED has 2 (resend, revoke). No dead ends.

findings.name: No duplicate transition rules
findings.finding: Transition rules consistent across both paths after consolidation.

findings.name: Consolidated invitation storage
findings.finding: All invitation storage uses employee_invites table. No more user_metadata JSON.

findings.name: No duplicate route registration
findings.finding: Previously shadowed /api/invite/{token} removed from onboarding_routes.py.

findings.name: Invite creation triggers email
findings.finding: Both paths trigger email_service.send_activation_email(). Error caught, invite succeeds even if email fails.

findings.name: Invite acceptance triggers user creation
findings.finding: Both activation endpoints create User from EmployeeInvite data with role, org, and access token.

findings.name: Expiration auto-detected on validation
findings.finding: Token validation lazy-checks expires_at and auto-transitions to EXPIRED. List endpoints also compute effective status via _effective_status().

findings.name: No proactive expiration sweep
findings.finding: No scheduled job to sweep expired invites. The _effective_status() fix handles display correctly but doesn't transition the DB record.
findings.recommendation: Consider a periodic sweep or pre-expiration admin notification.

findings.name: Invite expiration SLA defined
findings.finding: 7-day expiration consistent across both paths.

findings.name: No invite expiration escalation
findings.finding: No notification to admin when invite approaches expiration.

findings.name: Role-based invite permissions
findings.finding: Restricted to INVITE_GRANTING_ROLES: {admin, site_admin, leadership, management}.

findings.name: Role escalation prevention
findings.finding: Non-admin users cannot create admin-level invites.

findings.name: Seat limit enforcement with FOR UPDATE lock
findings.finding: Pessimistic locking prevents race condition on concurrent accepts.

findings.name: Tenant isolation on all invite operations
findings.finding: All CRUD enforces organization_id. Master admin (id=1) bypasses.

findings.name: Constant-time token comparison
findings.finding: hmac.compare_digest() used after indexed lookup in all token paths.

findings.name: Unified password policy on backend
findings.finding: validate_password() enforced on all activation paths.

findings.name: Frontend password validation aligned with backend constant
findings.finding: AcceptInvite.jsx imports PASSWORD_REQUIREMENTS from constants/roles.js and builds validation dynamically. Matches backend password_policy.py (min_length=8, require_uppercase=True, require_lowercase=True, require_digit=True).
findings.resolution: Replaced hardcoded regex with constant-driven validation.

findings.name: PII masking in audit logs
findings.finding: All logs use mask_email_for_audit().

findings.name: Rate limiting on public endpoints
findings.finding: Validate (10/5min), activate (5/5min), resend (5/5min) all rate-limited.

findings.name: No debug logging leak in TeamMembers.js
findings.finding: All 6 DEBUG console.log statements removed. No module-level console.log. Only legitimate console.error() calls remain in error handlers.

findings.name: CSRF protection on invite management components
findings.finding: InviteManagementTable.jsx and EmployeeInviteWizard.jsx now use the api axios instance from services/api.js. All POST operations (create, revoke, resend) go through axios interceptors with automatic CSRF token injection. Zero remaining raw fetch() calls.
findings.resolution: Replaced all fetch() calls with api.get()/api.post() from services/api.js.

findings.name: Audit log transaction ordering
findings.finding: Fixed: flush() before audit, commit after.

findings.name: Invite token cleared after use
findings.finding: Tokens set to None after acceptance and revocation.

findings.name: Response shape consistency
findings.finding: Both paths return same field names: id, email, first_name, last_name, job_title, permission_role, status, invite_token, created_at, expires_at, accepted_at.

findings.name: Revoke behavior consistency
findings.finding: Both paths allow revoking PENDING or EXPIRED invites.

findings.name: AcceptInvite role display uses ROLES constant
findings.finding: Line 258 uses ROLES[inviteData?.permission_role]?.label for display text and ?.className for styling, with fallback to raw role string.

findings.name: AcceptInvite error handling uses structured error codes
findings.finding: Lines 44-52 check error.error_code first (TOKEN_EXPIRED, TOKEN_USED), falling back to string matching only when no structured code is present.
findings.resolution: Added error_code check before string matching fallback.

findings.name: onboardingApi.js auth pattern consistent
findings.finding: All 5 admin-onboarding functions (saveCompanyProfile, saveAdminProfile, queueTeamInvites, createAdminSubscription, completeAdminOnboarding) now use getAuthHeaders() instead of raw localStorage.getItem('token').
findings.resolution: Replaced localStorage.getItem('token') with getAuthHeaders() on lines 441, 460, 479, 498, 516.

findings.name: Centralized API base URL
findings.finding: InviteManagementTable.jsx and EmployeeInviteWizard.jsx no longer define their own API_BASE. They use the api axios instance which has API_BASE_URL built into its baseURL config.
findings.resolution: Removed hardcoded API_BASE declarations, using api instance instead.

findings.name: EmployeeInviteWizard email check shows feedback on failure
findings.finding: checkEmailAvailability() now shows toast.warning() on network error explaining the check could not be performed, and allows admin to proceed (returns {available: true}).
findings.resolution: Added toast notification and permissive fallback on check failure.

findings.name: Invite list shows correct status for expired invites
findings.finding: Both list endpoints (user_invitation_routes.py and onboarding_extended_routes.py) include _effective_status() that checks expires_at < now() for pending invites and returns 'expired'. Token exposure also gated — expired pending invites no longer leak invite_token.
findings.resolution: Added _effective_status() function to both list endpoints.

findings.name: No module-level DEBUG log in TeamMembers.js
findings.finding: Module-level console.log removed. No DEBUG-prefixed logging anywhere in file.
findings.resolution: Removed as part of SEC-006 fix.

findings.name: 21 workflow roles seeded from frontend
findings.finding: Workflow roles seeded via API call from TeamMembers.js rather than migration.

findings.name: SCIM 2.0 provisioning has no UI
findings.finding: Backend has full RFC 7644 SCIM (1274 lines) but no admin UI for IdP configuration.

findings.name: Bulk CSV import bypasses invitation flow
findings.finding: Bulk-imported users are created directly, skipping invite lifecycle.
